title: Three commands in a chain
summary: Two pipes and three children: ls | sort -r | head -2.
hints: Two pipes, `p1` (ls to sort) and `p2` (sort to head). The middle child uses BOTH: `dup2(p1[0], 0)` and `dup2(p2[1], 1)`.
Every process must close ALL four pipe ends it does not use (the parent too), or the readers never see the end of the data.
